title: Even moments of the uniform norm
statement: For a finite set $\Omega$, a positive natural number $r$, and a function $f:\Omega\to\mathbb{R}$, the uniform $L^{2r}$ quantity of $f$, raised to the power $2r$, equals the uniform average of $f(x)^{2r}$ over $\Omega$.
